'''Yawrocca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She frequented the ''[[Four-and-a-Half]]'', an illegal [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of the [[City/Legends|city]]. During the war, Yawrocca was considered the reigning [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] champion of the cantina.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yawrocca first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. She is listed as a character players might interact with if they choose to play Dejarik, although no specific interaction is described.
